entries.en: Re-introduced the "ultrathink" keyword to enable high effort for the next turn
entries.zh: 重新加入 "ultrathink" 关键词，可让下一轮启用高强度思考

entries.en: Opus 4.6 now defaults to medium effort for Max and Team subscribers. Medium effort works well for most tasks — it's the sweet spot between speed and thoroughness. You can change this anytime with `/model`
entries.zh: Opus 4.6 对 Max 和 Team 订阅用户默认使用中等 effort。中等 effort 适合大多数任务，是速度和细致程度之间的平衡点。你随时可以用 `/model` 修改

entries.en: Removed Opus 4 and 4.1 from Claude Code on the first-party API — users with these models pinned are automatically moved to Opus 4.6
entries.zh: 第一方 API 上的 Claude Code 已移除 Opus 4 和 4.1；仍固定使用这些模型的用户会自动迁移到 Opus 4.6
